description: This Java class 'Creation' handles user account creation, including collecting user info, generating account numbers, and writing data to database files.

classes.name: Creation
classes.description: A class responsible for creating new user accounts, managing user input, and writing account data to files.

methods.name: createAccFun
methods.description: Creates a new account by gathering user info, generating account number, and updating database files.

methods.name: getUserInfoFromUser
methods.description: Prompts user for personal information and returns it as an array.

methods.name: accNoCreation
methods.description: Generates a new account number based on the last entry in credentials file.

methods.name: credWrite
methods.description: Writes the account number and password to credentials file.

methods.name: balWrite
methods.description: Initializes account balance in balance database.

methods.name: userWrite
methods.description: Stores user details in user database.
